entities.summary: Thomas Muffet was an English naturalist and physician. He is best known his study of insects and arthropods in regard to medicine, his support of the Paracelsian system of medicine, and his emphasis on the importance of experience over reputation in the field of medicine. He was an Anti-papist due to his Puritan beliefs.
